text: [photo: the start line this morning]
omg that light is perfect
Good one. Looks cold
It was 2 degrees
Ecaterina says send her the one with the tree
We're going to sleep. See you next week
Nice pic
nite Diana you owe me a coffee for that photo, i'm serious
Morning 🙂 is the east side still closed or did they open it back up
Still closed. Saw the fence yesterday
yes still closed, they're doing the drains. we start at the usual corner

[photo: the door on Lipscani I opened today]

Took me 40 min. Old owner had 3 keys and lost two
Ecaterina says it's my fault she was up at 6
Lol. Good work
[photo: the tree by the gate]
That's the one
long day at the café. 3 staff out sick going to bed early for once
Ecaterina says the tree photo is going on the fridge. I told her it's already on the phone
She says the phone doesn't count
Lol
she's right printed ones are better
Ha. I'd print it too
staff are back but one of them is still coughing. not letting her near the coffee machine
Tell her to go home. Cafe doesn't need a coughing barista
i know she won't, she says she's fine
Fence on the east side might come down Thursday. Ecaterina's cousin works at the council, she says maybe
If it opens I'll do the east loop. Otherwise same as always
Florin, the lamb is in the fridge. Don't eat it all tonight
I had one piece
Ok im off. Early start tomorrow
Morning. Did the council say anything about thursday
Not yet. Ecaterina's cousin says he will call after lunch
pls tell her to say yes the east loop is the good one
She heard you
Half the desk is out with flu. Month end is on me now
Not a complaint

[photo: the coffee machine with a handwritten sign taped to it, "NU ATINGEȚI"]

she made a sign i didnt ask her to
she says its for the customers. they're all looking at her
The cousin says a man comes Thursday to look at the fence. He might not come. Don't promise anybody anything
Ok
so maybe thursday
Patient brought me a cake today. Said I deserve it for all the calf work. Thats 3 patients this week with cake 😅
Ok off to bed
closing up. the coughing one went home!! she didnt even argue much
Ecaterina is asleep. Fence is still up
